name: group.R_sys_scale
notes: Coupled calibration scale for R.SAR, R.SC. Grouped scale bound is dimensionless relative to the BSA-scaled baseline. Vascular compliance is derived from resistance using the Kung/Pennati-Fumero resting R-C relation.

name: R.SVEN
notes: Venous resistance prior remains slightly wider while paired compliance is derived through the resting R-C coupling relation.

name: group.R_pul_scale
notes: Coupled calibration scale for R.PAR, R.PCOX, R.PVEN. Grouped scale bound is dimensionless relative to the BSA-scaled baseline. Vascular compliance is derived from resistance using the Kung/Pennati-Fumero resting R-C relation.

name: C.SAR
notes: Systemic arterial compliance is anchored to stroke volume over systemic pulse pressure, with only a narrow residual tuning interval. Registry lower bound widened to keep the BSA-scaled reference feasible for C.SAR when clinical seeding is uncertain.

name: C.PAR
notes: Pulmonary arterial compliance is anchored to stroke volume over pulmonary pulse pressure, with a narrow residual tuning interval. Registry lower bound widened to keep the BSA-scaled reference feasible for C.PAR when clinical seeding is uncertain.

name: E.LV.EA
notes: Elastance prior is tightened around the allometric pediatric anchor.

name: E.LV.EB
notes: Elastance prior is tightened around the allometric pediatric anchor.

name: E.RV.EA
notes: Elastance prior is tightened around the allometric pediatric anchor.

name: E.RV.EB
notes: Elastance prior is tightened around the allometric pediatric anchor.

name: E.LA.EA
notes: Atrial elastance prior is wider because sparse catheter records usually provide only mean filling pressures.

name: E.RA.EA
notes: Atrial elastance prior is wider because sparse catheter records usually provide only mean filling pressures.

name: V0.LV
notes: Unstressed-volume prior is tied to blood-volume and preload consistency rather than a broad free search box. Registry upper bound widened to include clinically seeded start for V0.LV. Scaled baseline remains the plausibility anchor.

name: V0.RV
notes: Unstressed-volume prior is tied to blood-volume and preload consistency rather than a broad free search box. Registry upper bound widened to include clinically seeded start for V0.RV. Scaled baseline remains the plausibility anchor.

name: vsd.Cd
notes: Discharge coefficient is constrained to a physiologic orifice-flow interval. Registry upper bound widened to keep the BSA-scaled reference feasible for vsd.Cd when clinical seeding is uncertain.
